status.description: Cell availability only; exact execution state remains owned by the referenced Run.

reason.description: Stable, redacted explanation intended for failed or skipped cells; provider payloads are not exposed.

message.description: Bounded public message with secrets and provider details removed.

value.description: Bounded scalar output for the first product vertical; null is explicit, while nested arrays and objects are rejected.

value.description: Bounded scalar value; null is explicit and distinct from an omitted field entry. Nested arrays and objects are rejected.
